question: Average order value per channel?
referenceSql: SELECT o.Channel, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS AverageOrderValue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId GROUP BY o.Channel ORDER BY o.Channel
